name: The Cold Room — the parent
notes:
The real combat of the adventure, and it is a puzzle.

SPLIT: hit by piercing or slashing at 10+ HP and it becomes two oozes at half HP each. It is also immune to both. So the attack does nothing AND doubles the problem. A party that opens with a rapier turns one Gargantuan ooze into two. Then four. In a walk-in.

The answers are bludgeoning, fire, spells dealing neither piercing nor slashing, or shutting the door and solving Fault III another way.

Killing it PERMANENTLY stops the aspic re-forming in every subsequent loop. It is the only progress in the adventure that survives a reset. Tell them it stuck — they will feel that win enormously.

Flag: some printings say the acid damages flesh only, not bone, stone or wood. Not confirmed on the current Nethys page — treat as flavour, not a ruling.
terrain: Kitchen walk-in cold room. Cramped for something Gargantuan.
lighting: Dim. One lantern by the door.

creatures.displayName: The thing the aspic came from
